name: CJIS Policy Pack
description: DLP controls aligned to the FBI Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Security Policy. Detects Criminal Justice Information (CJI) including CHRI markings, NCIC/III references, law-enforcement-sensitive content, and criminal-justice PII (FBI UCN, ORI, SID, RAP sheet terminology). Policies are delivered in ALLOW/monitor mode; flip to BLOCK after tuning. All rules ship DISABLED at INFO severity (Zscaler's delivery convention): review, tune, then enable each rule and raise its severity.

confidence_tweaks.label: Medical → Low (reduce FPs on mixed police/medical intake)

audience: State and local law enforcement, courts, and any agency or contractor that handles Criminal Justice Information (CJI).
when_to_use: The customer must comply with the FBI CJIS Security Policy, or handles criminal history, NCIC/III, warrants, biometrics or firearms background-check data.
notes: US PII and TLP coverage come from the Fed pack (CJIS- prefixed copies of its dictionaries; the pack's own CJIS Prox 500 clones are reused): identity data of subjects, victims, witnesses and officers that state breach law reaches outside any CJI marking, and the TLP:RED / AMBER+STRICT / AMBER markings law-enforcement information sharing runs under.
